name: Ryn
title: Silent Felari Scout & Tracker
quote: Words are loud. Steel is quieter.

appearance.build: Lean and wiry with quiet strength
appearance.hair: Short dark tawny with subtle black markings
appearance.scent: Pine, cold steel, and faint snow
appearance.posture: Still and watchful, moves like a ghost

siblings.Deceased: Entire pride lost to wyvern raid

appearance.tails: One long spotted tail that rarely moves unless alert

reactions.sound: Ears swivel toward source, body freezes
reactions.temperature: Fur bristles in cold, seeks shelter

speech.growth: From lone survivor to loyal crew member

beneath: Deep grief from losing entire pride
Fear of forming new bonds that could be lost
vulnerabilities: Emotional detachment makes him seem cold
growth: From expecting to die alone → slowly learning to trust a new family

fears: Losing his new crew the way he lost his pride

future.symbol: A still spotted tail in the snow
future.role: Quiet protector and tracker for Sable’s crew
future.arc: From lone survivor expecting to die alone → learning to trust and protect a new family
